workerResult.summary: OAT MANTIS MINSTER 麦截 — a 30-second Japanese-cyberpunk snip ritual. Chrome mantis priest cuts falling oats at a neon line; perfects build a x5 chain and fill six sutra glyphs, three missed oats ring the gate closed. Result panel ranks the run, shares a haiku + challenge link, and exports a 1080x1350 ofuda PNG. All sound is synthesised with WebAudio (no assets), single-button playable in 30 seconds, best score/mute in localStorage, no backend. Rebuilt from an empty scaffold: Vite 8 + React 19 + TS strict + Tailwind v4, base './' relative assets, pure-rules engine with assert self-check.
